title: The Woolly Mammoth Billionaire’s New Startup Is Genetically Engineering War Dogs For The Military
summary: Ben Lamm of de-extinction startup Colossal has teamed up with Palmer Luckey’s team at Anduril to create a dog that’s optimized for military use. The new “warhounds” will be cloned and gene edited.
